notes: Portable Dimension-table default range upper-bound preflight through official Federation Create and dimension lookup services. The adapter supplies provider package, standard MIM, two schema-valid otherwise-matched FOM bindings, endpoint, logical time, and callback model. For upperBound 100, [0..101) is rejected with InconsistentFOM while [0..100) is accepted. Other integer forms, Excluded, private diagnostics, Java provider runtime, and interoperability are not claimed. The existing generic invalid-FOM corpus includes an out-of-range fixture but permits multiple failure types and has no matched boundary control.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador Create Federation Execution with MIM, Join, dimension handle/name/upper-bound lookups, Resign and Destroy
